rows.name: spoken-why-warps-frozen-5
rows.question: Why
rows.answer: Because threads in a warp share instruction-issue resources, similar control flow and consecutive memory access make better use of the GPU. When threads branch differently, the different paths execute with only the relevant threads active, leaving other lanes idle. Accessing consecutive memory locations also lets the GPU combine accesses into fewer memory transactions, improving efficiency.
